1.w: To everything [there is] a season, and a time for every [thing] desired under the heavens:

2.w: A time to give birth and a time to die, a time to plant and a time to pluck up the planted,

3.w: a time to kill and a time to heal, a time to break down and a time to build up,

4.w: a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance,

5.w: a time to cast away stones and a time to gather stones, a time to embrace and a time to refrain from embracing,

6.w: a time to seek and a time to lose, a time to keep and a time to cast away,

7.w: a time to tear and a time to sew, a time to be silent and a time to speak,

8.w: a time to love and a time to hate, a time of war and a time of peace.

9.w: What [is] the profit of the one making in that which he toils?

10.w: I have seen the task that God has given to the sons of man, to be occupied with it.

11.w: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also eternity put in their heart, without which a man cannot find out the work that God has done from beginning even to end.

12.w: I know that there is nothing good for them, but than to rejoice and to do good during their lives,

13.w: and also [that] every man should eat and drink and see good in all his toil—it [is] a gift of God.

14.w: I know that everything that God does, it will be forever; to it nothing can be added, and from it nothing can be diminished; and God has done [it] that they should fear from before His face.

15.w: That which has been already, it [is]; and that which is to be, it has already been—and God requires that which is pursued.

16.w: And again I saw under the sun that in the place of judgment there [was] wickedness, and [in] the place of righteousness, there [was] wickedness.

17.w: I said in my heart, “The righteous and the wicked, God will judge, because a time [is] to every activity, and for every work there.”

18.w: I said in my heart concerning the manner of the sons of man, “God [is] testing them, that they might see that they [are] beasts—they themselves.”

19.w: For an event [is to] the sons of man, and an event [is to] the beasts, one [is] and an event for them: As the death of this one, so [is] the death of this one; and one breath [is] to all, and the advantage of the man over the beast [is] nothing—for all [is] vapor.

20.w: All are going to one place; all are from the dust, and all return to the dust.

21.w: Who knows [if] the spirit of the sons of man, it is ascending upward, and the spirit of the beast, it is desending downward into the earth?

22.w: And I saw that nothing [is] better than that the man should rejoice in his own works, for that [is] his portion. For who can bring him to see what will come after him?
